baseline.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE "__exportlite_batches"("bounds") AS (
    SELECT json_array(min("key"), max("key"), count(*))
    FROM (SELECT "rowid" AS "key" FROM main."users" AS "__exportlite_source" ORDER BY "rowid" LIMIT 256)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT (
      SELECT json_array(min("key"), max("key"), count(*))
      FROM (SELECT "rowid" AS "key" FROM main."users" AS "__exportlite_source"
        WHERE "rowid" > json_extract("__exportlite_batches"."bounds", '$[1]')
        ORDER BY "rowid" LIMIT 256)
    )
    FROM "__exportlite_batches"
    WHERE json_extract("bounds", '$[2]') > 0
  )
  SELECT (
    SELECT json_group_array(json_object('name', "name"))
    FROM (SELECT "name" FROM main."users" AS "__exportlite_source"
      WHERE "rowid" BETWEEN json_extract("__exportlite_batches"."bounds", '$[0]')
        AND json_extract("__exportlite_batches"."bounds", '$[1]')
      ORDER BY "rowid")
  ), json_extract("bounds", '$[2]')
  FROM "__exportlite_batches"
  WHERE json_extract("bounds", '$[2]') > 0

fixed-boundaries.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE "__exportlite_batches"("first", "last") AS (
    SELECT
      (SELECT rowid FROM main."users" AS "__exportlite_source" ORDER BY rowid LIMIT 1),
      (SELECT rowid FROM main."users" AS "__exportlite_source" ORDER BY rowid LIMIT 1 OFFSET 255)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      (SELECT rowid FROM main."users" AS "__exportlite_source" WHERE rowid > "__exportlite_batches"."last" ORDER BY rowid LIMIT 1),
      (SELECT rowid FROM main."users" AS "__exportlite_source" WHERE rowid > "__exportlite_batches"."last" ORDER BY rowid LIMIT 1 OFFSET 255)
    FROM "__exportlite_batches" WHERE "__exportlite_batches"."last" IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT (
    SELECT json_group_array(json_object('name', "name"))
    FROM (SELECT "name" FROM main."users" AS "__exportlite_source"
      WHERE rowid BETWEEN "__exportlite_batches"."first" AND coalesce("__exportlite_batches"."last", 9223372036854775807)
      ORDER BY rowid)
  ), CASE WHEN "__exportlite_batches"."last" IS NOT NULL THEN 256 ELSE
    (SELECT count(*) FROM main."users" AS "__exportlite_source" WHERE rowid >= "__exportlite_batches"."first") END
  FROM "__exportlite_batches" WHERE "__exportlite_batches"."first" IS NOT NULL
